comparison.objective: Certify a patch cord by inserting both ends into tester jacks; candidate adjusts and locks a gripper opening stop, then cycles it.
comparison.physical_skill: Two-ended cable handling and connector insertion versus concentric driver/wrench seating, countertorque, and stop adjustment.
comparison.success_condition: Both plugs released at specified insertion depth versus retained 90° opening, locked nuts, three repeatable cycles, and tool clearance.
comparison.reason: The record tests deformable-cable connector insertion, not preservation of a mechanical adjustment while tightening a jam nut.
